factory.name: DataTable.create | DataTableColumnChooser.create | downloadCsv
factory.signature: DataTable.create<Row>(host: HTMLElement, options: DataTableOptions<Row>): DataTable<Row>; DataTableColumnChooser.create<Row>(trigger: HTMLButtonElement, table: DataTable<Row>, options?: DataTableColumnChooserOptions): DataTableColumnChooser<Row>; downloadCsv(csv: string | Blob, filename: string, doc?: Document): void

options.name: caption
options.description: Table caption; the accessible name of the table and its scroll region.

options.name: hideCaption
options.description: Visually hide the caption (it stays the accessible name).

options.name: columns
options.description: Column definitions: id, header, accessor, and optional type, currency, format, render, sortable, compare, align, width, rowHeader; since 0.3.0 also filter, filterOptions, searchable, hideable, resizable, minWidth, maxWidth, exportable, exportValue; since 0.9.0 also aggregate, renderHeader, editable, editor, editOptions, validate, renderEditor.

options.name: rows
options.description: All rows (client mode) or the current page (server mode).

options.name: rowId
options.description: Stable, unique, non-empty id per row. Duplicates throw DATA_TABLE_ROW_ID.

options.name: sort
options.description: Current sort; each column must be sortable and appear once. An array (since 0.3.0) sorts by several columns, first entry first.

options.name: selected
options.description: Selected row ids.

options.name: isRowSelectable
options.description: Rows returning false get a disabled selection input and are skipped by select all and range selection.

options.name: pageSizes
options.description: Render a 'Rows per page' select in the composed Pagination.

options.name: page
options.description: Current page, 1-based; clamped to the page count.

options.name: mode
options.description: client filters, sorts, and pages rows locally; server renders rows as the current page and only emits events.

options.name: total
options.description: Server mode: total rows across all pages (required when paged).

options.name: loading
options.description: aria-busy on the region, an announced 'Loading' status, skeleton rows when empty, otherwise an overlay over existing rows.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: Text shown when there are no rows (also when filters match nothing).

options.name: filters
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Active column filters by column id; each filter type must match the column's filter kind (text, number, date, enum). JSON-safe.

options.name: search
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Global search text: every whitespace-separated term must appear in the displayed text of some visible, searchable column (case-insensitive).

options.name: searchable
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Render a labelled search field in a role=search toolbar above the table.

options.name: filterRow
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Render the filter row when a visible column has a filter; false keeps filters programmatic.

options.name: hiddenColumns
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Hidden column ids; at least one column stays visible.

options.name: columnOrder
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Display order by column id; unlisted columns follow in definition order.

options.name: columnWidths
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Border-box column widths in CSS pixels, clamped to each column's minWidth/maxWidth. Any entry switches the table to a fixed layout.

options.name: pinnedColumns
options.type: { start?: readonly string[]; end?: readonly string[] }
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Sticky columns at the inline start and end edges, outermost first (logical edges, so right-to-left layouts mirror). Pinned columns move to their edge; start pins also pin the selection and disclosure columns.

options.name: resizable
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Resize handles (focusable separators) on column headers for pointer drag and arrow keys; a column's resizable overrides it.

options.name: renderDetail
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Row detail content; enables a disclosure button per row. Called when a row is first expanded; returned Nodes are consumer-owned, strings are text. Not combinable with virtual.

options.name: isRowExpandable
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Rows returning false get no disclosure button.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Expanded row ids (pruned like the selection).

options.name: virtual
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Windowed rendering of the current page inside the scroll region (single-line rows of uniform height); aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex describe the full set.

options.name: rowHeight
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Virtual mode: initial row height estimate in CSS pixels (16 to 500), replaced by the measured height.

options.name: groupBy
options.description: Group rows by these column ids, nested in order (since 0.9.0). Client mode only; not with virtual.

options.name: collapsedGroups
options.description: Collapsed group keys; groups are expanded by default (since 0.9.0).

options.name: renderGroupHeader
options.description: Custom group header content (since 0.9.0); decorative, released with releaseNode when dropped.

options.name: showTotals
options.description: Show the totals row when a column aggregates or totals is set (since 0.9.0).

options.name: totals
options.description: Server mode: totals by column id, computed by the server (since 0.9.0).

options.name: renderEmpty
options.description: Custom empty-state content (since 0.9.0); replaces emptyMessage, released with releaseNode when dropped.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ sortAscending: IconRef; sortDescending: IconRef; sortNone: IconRef; checked: IconRef; indeterminate: IconRef; loading: IconRef; expand: IconRef; collapse: IconRef }>
options.description: Icon slot overrides (expand and collapse since 0.3.0).

options.name: selection
options.description: Row selection: radios (single) or checkboxes with select all (multiple).

options.name: pageSize
options.description: Rows per page (1 to 1,000,000); null renders all rows without pagination.

options.name: stickyHeader
options.description: Keep the header rows (and the filter row) visible while the scroll region scrolls.

options.name: sortCycle
options.description: tri-state: ascending, descending, unsorted. bi-state: ascending, descending.

options.name: multiSort
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Shift+click or Shift+Enter/Space on a sort button adds the column to the sort (or cycles it in place).

options.name: filterDelay
options.description: Since 0.3.0. Milliseconds (0 to 5000) between the last keystroke in a text or number filter or the search field and filtering; Enter, blur, and select/date changes apply immediately.

options.name: locale
options.description: Messages, number/date formatting, text collation, and case-insensitive matching.

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA timezone for datetime columns: formatting and date filters.

options.name: density
options.description: Cell padding.

options.name: direction
options.description: Passed to the composed Pagination (mirrors its chevrons).

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: filters
properties.description: Since 0.3.0. Active filters by column id (a copy).

properties.name: collapsedGroups
properties.description: Since 0.9.0. Keys of collapsed groups (a copy).

properties.name: rowCount
properties.description: Since 0.3.0. Rows matching the filters and search across all pages (client mode), or total (server mode).

properties.name: pageSize
properties.description: Rows per page, or null when paging is off.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Selected row ids in selection order (a copy).

properties.name: trigger | table | menu
properties.description: Since 0.3.0. DataTableColumnChooser: its trigger button, the table it controls, and the composed Menu.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options. Row elements are reused for unchanged rows; selection keeps ids that are still present (client mode). Emits nothing.

methods.name: setRows
methods.signature: setRows(rows: readonly Row[], total?: number): void

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Replace the selection without events. Unknown (client mode) and unselectable ids are dropped.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. JSON-safe snapshot: { version: 1, sort, filters, search, columns: { order, hidden, widths, pinned }, page, pageSize, collapsedGroups (since 0.9.0) }.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. Restore a snapshot or any subset of it (omitted parts are unchanged). Validates untrusted input (DATA_TABLE_STATE on malformed structure, state unchanged); unknown column ids and values a column cannot take are dropped. Emits nothing.

methods.name: toCsv
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. RFC 4180 CSV of visible/all/named columns and filtered/page/selected/all rows, formatted or raw values, with formula-injection protection. No side effects.

methods.name: toCsvBlob
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. toCsv() as a text/csv;charset=utf-8 Blob.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, timers, observers, the composed Pagination, and subscriptions.

methods.name: DataTableColumnChooser.refresh
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. Rebuild the chooser items from the table's columns and visibility (also done on open and after user changes).

methods.name: DataTableColumnChooser.destroy
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. Remove the chooser's listeners and its Menu (the trigger button stays).

methods.name: downloadCsv
methods.signature: downloadCsv(csv: string | Blob, filename: string, doc?: Document): void
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. Save CSV through a temporary object URL and an <a download> click. The only download side effect; nothing calls it implicitly.

events.name: aui-sort-change
events.description: The user activated a sort button (sorts since 0.3.0). Informative in client mode; in server mode load sorted rows. The page returns to 1.

events.name: aui-selection-change
events.description: The user changed the selection (row input, select all, or Shift+click range).

events.name: aui-page-change
events.description: The user changed the page or page size. Informative in client mode; in server mode load that page.

events.name: aui-filter-change
events.description: Since 0.3.0. The user changed a column filter or the global search. The page returns to 1. In server mode load matching rows (read table.getState() for the full query).

events.name: aui-columns-change
events.description: Since 0.3.0. The user showed or hid a column (column chooser) or resized one (on release, or per resize key).

events.name: aui-expand-change
events.detail: { id: string; expanded: boolean; expandedIds: string[] }
events.description: Since 0.3.0. The user expanded or collapsed a row.

events.name: aui-group-toggle
events.detail: { key: string; collapsed: boolean; collapsedGroups: string[] }
events.description: The user expanded or collapsed a group (since 0.9.0).

events.name: aui-cell-edit
events.detail: { rowId: string; row: Row; column: string; value: unknown; previous: unknown }
events.description: The user committed an inline edit (since 0.9.0); update rows with value.

contentAreas.name: column render()
contentAreas.description: Custom cell content per column: a string (rendered as text) or a consumer-owned Node.

contentAreas.name: renderDetail()
contentAreas.description: Since 0.3.0. Row detail content under an expanded row: a consumer-owned Node or a string (text). Kept while the row stays expanded and its object is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table--virtual
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Virtual mode (the region gets max-block-size: 70vh; override it on the region).

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table--fixed
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Fixed table layout with pixel column widths (after a resize or with columnWidths).

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table--pinned
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. At least one column is pinned.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table--resizing
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. A pointer resize is in progress.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__toolbar | __search | __search-label | __search-input
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Search toolbar (role=search) and its labelled field.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__control
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Native filter and search fields.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__body
cssClasses.description: Positioning wrapper for the region and the loading status.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__head | __header-row
cssClasses.description: The <thead> (sticky as a whole) and its header row.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__header-cell--sorted
cssClasses.description: A sorted column header (every sort column).

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__sort | __sort-label | __sort-icon | __sort-priority
cssClasses.description: Sort button and its parts (priority number since 0.3.0, shown while sorting by several columns).

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__filter-row | __filter-cell | __filter-input | __filter-range | __filter-select
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Filter row and its controls.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__cell--pinned | --pinned-start | --pinned-end | --pinned-edge
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Sticky cells of pinned columns; the edge class marks the innermost pinned column of each side.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__expand-cell | __expander | __expander-icon
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Disclosure column and its button.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__detail-row | __detail
cssClasses.description: Since 0.3.0. Detail row of an expanded row and its full-width cell.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__cell
cssClasses.description: Body cell (td, or th scope=row for the row header).

cssClasses.name: aui-data-table__box | __check | __check--checkbox | __check--radio | __mark
cssClasses.description: Native selection input and its mark.
